subject: Priv-term: Subprocessor archive rollback & log-exemption runbook
messages:
From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@spectralabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@spectralabs.com
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary archive rollback + log retention carveout

Hi Kimberly,

We're starting a regulatory readiness audit next week and the auditors have asked for a 45-day snapshot of activity and an ability to temporarily restore certain archived customer events tied to clinical workflows. Spectra Labs uses Redwood for inference in our analytics pipeline; the team is asking whether Redwood can hold backups and logs beyond our standard retention for a narrow window and provide a documented rollback plan for a subset of subprocessor-stored archives.

Specifically we need: 
- A 45-day temporary extension on backup retention for Org: Spectra Labs (cust-id SL-8842)
- An auditable rollback runbook for archives created between 2025-06-01 and 2025-08-31 (approx 12 GB)
- Confirmation of which subprocessors would access restored data and an updated DPA addendum if needed

Can you confirm feasibility and next steps? We're happy to sign an addendum or SOW to cover costs. If helpful I can loop in our security contact (audit+security@spectralabs.com).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Martin
Head of Regulatory Affairs
Spectra Labs
[Attachment: priv-intake-form.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@spectralabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary archive rollback + log retention carveout

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the intake form. I copied legal (karthik) and infra (Marcus) to scope operational and contractual implications. High level: we can usually support a time-limited retention hold and a rollback playbook, but I need to confirm subprocessors and the technical snapshot/restore path for the specific date range.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Marcus to confirm technical feasibility and whether we can provide an immutable snapshot for the date range you specified.
2) Karthik to draft a focused DPA addendum (limited in scope and duration) that captures the retention extension and subprocessor list.
3) We schedule a short call to align on SLs and cost (30 min).

Can you do Tues 11/4 10am PT? If not propose two times. I'll prepare a draft addendum and a retention matrix after Marcus confirms sizes.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: priv-intake-form.pdf (re-sent)]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary archive rollback + log retention carveout

Kim / Karthik — quick ops note after an initial look:
- The snapshot range (2025-06-01 to 2025-08-31) maps to three incremental backup batches; total size ~12.3 GB across two object stores (us-west-2 primary, archive in us-east-1).
- We can create an immutable escrow snapshot and hold it for 45 days. Restore path: scoped restore into an isolated tenant sandbox (read-only) so Spectra can provide auditors access without exposing live infra.
- Subprocessors: S3 provider (us-west-2), object-replication subcontractor (ArchiveCo), and the managed backup operator (Redwood BackupOps team). We'll enumerate contact points in the addendum.
- Operational constraints: rolling back requires a 4-hour maintenance window (non-disruptive to live service if done into sandbox) and a formal rollback ticket with change advisory.

I attached a quick retention_matrix.xlsx to outline cost and timelines. If legal wants a 30 vs 45 day window we can accommodate; longer than 60 days starts hitting archival restore costs.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: retention_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary archive rollback + log retention carveout

Kim / Marcus — legal perspective and suggested language: 
- Draft a narrowly-scoped DPA addendum limited to: (a) Org SL-8842, (b) retention hold covering snapshots listed, (c) 45-day extension, (d) limited purpose: regulatory audit only, (e) explicit list of subprocessors and permitted access patterns.
- We should include obligations for: chain-of-custody logs, proof of deletion after the window, and an attestation from BackupOps when purge completes.
- Proposed clause for subprocessor access: "Subprocessors may access restored data only to perform restore and validation activities; all access will be logged and subject to audit by Spectra Labs within the 45-day window."

Attached is a starter draft of the DPA addendum. I'll circulate an updated version after input from Marcus on exact subprocessors and the sandbox workflow.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: dpa_addendum_draft.docx (docx)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@spectralabs.com>, audit+security@spectralabs.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary archive rollback + log retention carveout — Next steps and sign-off

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience while we scoped this. Summary and agreed next steps: 

1) Scope: Redwood will create an immutable escrow snapshot for Spectra Labs (Org SL-8842) covering archives created from 2025-06-01 through 2025-08-31. We will hold the snapshot for a 45-day retention extension for the purpose of the regulatory audit only.

2) Subprocessors: Confirmed list — S3 Provider (primary), ArchiveCo (replication), Redwood BackupOps (managed restores). Karthik will add these to the addendum with contact roles.

3) Operational plan: Restore will run into an isolated read-only sandbox. Estimated maintenance window for any restore work: up to 4 hours. All access will be logged and a chain-of-custody report produced. Marcus' retention_matrix.xlsx estimates added cost at ~$320 for the 45-day hold; we'll invoice this as a one-time addendum fee unless you request an SOW.

4) Contracts: Karthik attached a DPA addendum draft. If that looks good to you we'll route it for signature via DocuSign and aim to complete signatures by 11/10. Link to DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-DocuSign-Link-Placeholder

5) Meeting: I booked Tue 11/4 10am PT to review technical details and sign-off. Calendar invite sent separately.

Please reply with any redlines to the DPA draft; we'll turn them around quickly. Once signed we'll schedule the snapshot and provide the chain-of-custody report at the end of the 45-day window and confirm purge.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: dpa_addendum_draft.docx, retention_matrix.xlsx]
